title: Gandhari Vidya Intake & Interest Form
description: Discover and awaken extra-ocular perception (blindsight). Register your interest for upcoming batches.

blocks.title: Welcome to Gandhari Vidya
blocks.description: Experience the ancient science of intuitive vision and blindfolded perception — akin to modern blindsight. Learn more at [Hrid Vidya](https://gandharividya.hridvidya.com/). Let's explore your journey and find the right batch for you.

blocks.title: Who are you filling this application for?
blocks.description: The program is specifically structured for ages 6 to 25.

blocks.title: Your Contact Details
blocks.description: We will share orientation materials and batch announcements here.

blocks.title: What is the participant's age?
blocks.description: Participants must be between 6 and 25 years old to enrol in the core Gandhari Vidya modules.

blocks.title: Do you know someone between 6 and 25 years old who would benefit from Gandhari Vidya?
blocks.description: Our current courses are designed for participants aged 6–25.

blocks.title: Referral Contact Details
blocks.description: Please provide the contact details of the person you are referring.

blocks.title: Have you ever experienced or witnessed blindfolded perception (blindsight) before?
blocks.description: No prior experience is necessary; we customize foundational exercises to your familiarity.

options.label: Yes, watched videos / read about it
Heard of it, but new to the practice

blocks.title: What excites you most about developing Gandhari Vidya?
blocks.description: Select all aspects that spark your curiosity.

options.label: Scientific understanding of blindsight and neuroplasticity

blocks.title: What course format best fits your schedule?
blocks.description: Program duration adapts monthly based on batch depth and seasonal schedules.

options.label: Flexible / Open to any upcoming schedule

blocks.title: Preferred session timing window
blocks.description: Batches are conducted in small groups for focused guidance.

blocks.title: Course Registration & Next Steps
blocks.description: The course fee is ₹10,000 per participant for any enrolled batch. How would you like to proceed?

options.label: Ready to reserve a seat for the next batch (₹10,000)
Interested in attending a preliminary briefing / Q&A first
Keep me on the monthly announcement waitlist

blocks.title: Gandhari Vidya Batch Registration Fee
blocks.description: Complete your payment via checkout link to confirm your seat reservation.

blocks.title: Any specific goals or questions for the instructor?
blocks.description: Share anything you would like us to know regarding focus areas, expectations, or schedule constraints.

endings.title: Registration Received!
endings.bodyMd: Thank you for stepping into the world of Gandhari Vidya. Our team will review your batch preferences and reach out via email and phone with the upcoming schedule details.

endings.title: Eligibility Criteria Not Met
endings.bodyMd: Thank you for your interest in Gandhari Vidya. Currently, the developmental framework and training methodologies are formulated exclusively for participants aged 6 to 25 years.

endings.title: Thank You for the Referral!
endings.bodyMd: We have received the referral details and will reach out to them soon.
